body:
Milestone 9 (`project-pages`): three more project home pages get a figure from the project's own output.

- Each project gets a stdlib-only `experiments/figure.py` that reads the committed `results.json` and writes `experiments/carry_time.svg` (carry time vs joint-speed limit or jaw-force cap, first L=0.08 m block). Nothing is retyped; labelled stylised simulation.
- README of each gets the figure under Results.
- `python site/build.py` prints `ok: 393 projects, 3437 tests`; the project pages pick up the image. Rendered the SVGs in headless Chromium to check them.

No project code, results or citations changed.
